scope: Three V18 waiting states. Same fitted trip laws, physical platform, candidate menu, and exact-second interpolation. No new actual dates or retuning on the evaluation tape.
continuation: After a fixed path's first transfer fails publicly or its issued attempt expires, take the first visible legal direct-to-goal option from a frozen timetable menu at that platform. Use this same rule on selected immediate paths and on original A/B paths reached by waiting. Later failures keep the deadline cost.
contrasts: local_execution changes only execution after a transfer miss. local_original_menu also charges that continuation to the expected loss on both sides. local_matched_120 includes all scored through trips in future waiting, including those admitted by the support screen. Primary local_matched uses the same menus and scores with zero margin in both immediate and projected future offer comparisons. Use no tuned trip IDs or success threshold.
waiting_model: Evaluate future direct and the original A/B offers with V18's independent departure-event projection, including the same transfer rescue on A/B. Future optional transfer offers are outside this waiting approximation. Immediate offers use their public departure and the same fixed-path continuation.
paired_worlds: 256 per root at [20261119, int(date), query, decision, 0]. Common root+30-second release if charged preparation and binding fit. Measure cold independent arm preparation, binding, action, applicability, and incumbent cost. Statistical results apply to the frozen fitted model and release.
gate: Primary only, joint .05 across three roots, V16 one-sided complement product test for the full-graph hindsight-gap upper bound. Report differences among other arms descriptively. Full G2 also requires same-public-information optimized generic planning and computational evidence. No extension of this tape.
old_failures: Separate outcome-selected mechanism replay of known V17 and V18 misses, forcing the historical first connection to isolate rescue. Excluded from independent means and confidence bounds.
